## Why This Is Asked
Assesses ability to design privacy‑aware, tenant-scoped analytics with dbt macros, incremental modeling, and governance gates.

```sql
SELECT hex(digest(concat({{ email }}, salt_for_tenant('{{{{ tenant }}}}')), 256))

```

## Why This Is Asked

This question evaluates the ability to design a scalable, multi-tenant dbt architecture using seed-driven tenant management. It tests understanding of macro-based schema generation, data quality testing, and governance practices in a multi-tenant Snowflake environment.

## Key Concepts

- dbt macros for dynamic model generation
- Seed-based tenant registry management
- Per-tenant schema naming conventions
- 1-day late data handling strategies
- Data quality testing (not_null, unique)
- Global analytics.lineage for governance
- CI automation for tenant coverage validation
- Cross-tenant data isolation principles

## Code Example

```javascript
{% macro onboarding_daily_sql(tenant) -%}
SELECT
  '{{tenant}}' AS tenant_id,
  user_id,
  action,
  occurred_at
FROM staging.tenant_events
WHERE tenant_id = '{{tenant}}'
  AND occurred_at >= DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE())
{% endmacro %}

-- Main model using the macro
{% for tenant in seeds.tenants %}
{{ onboarding_daily_sql(tenant) }}
{% endfor %}
```

```javascript
)
select * from s
```
